definitions.explanation: The general concept of time, or a period/amount of time. {時間|じかん}がない (no time), {時間|じかん}がかかる (takes time).
Used as a counter for hours. {三時間|さんじかん} (three hours).

examples.japanese: {二時間|にじかん}かかりました。
{時間|じかん}を{大切|たいせつ}にしてください。

notes: {時間|じかん} as a counter for hours: {一時間|いちじかん}, {二時間|にじかん}, {三時間|さんじかん}, etc. Don't confuse with {時|じ} which marks clock time ({三時|さんじ} = 3 o'clock) versus duration ({三時間|さんじかん} = 3 hours). {時間|じかん} can also refer to a class period in school contexts.
